title: Rava bar Yosef
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sukkah 34a after Abaye; in Shabbat 36a the statement is attributed to Rav Ashi (Hyman identifies him as Rava without further designation).
In Bava Metzia 67a he speaks in Rava’s name according to the Rosh’s reading; the Gemara reads “Mar son of Rav Yosef in Rava’s name.”
